content.short: Finoa is a regulated European custodian helping businesses move capital on-chain.
content.description: Finoa, founded in 2019 in Germany, provides regulated custody and related infrastructure for institutions and companies moving capital into the on-chain economy, including staking and token management. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Finoa.
content.meta: Finoa is a regulated European digital asset custodian for institutions, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
